messages:
anya: Heads-up: tenant 'green-data' reported a routing rollback to default pool but console shows no audit row. saw it at ~21:04 UTC in their traces (trace id t-3c9d).

pat: which flag/key?

anya: key `routes.main.priority`. App log: 'applied fallback route' and request-id `r-44f2`. Console_audit query for that tenant/time returned nothing.

pat: could be the ephemeral apply path (persist=false). We still allow it for oncall but it must emit an audit entry. Any control-plane logs?

anya: control-plane shows `audit.write timeout` at 21:04:12 and runtime returned 200. so runtime applied but audit write failed.

pat: that's bad. short-term: flip runtime to fail-closed on audit write failures. long-term: (1) reconcile job to detect runtime-vs-control diffs and surface "Unrecorded runtime change", (2) console action to create backfill audit row with attached evidence, (3) return structured headers from runtime apply calls: `X-Audit-Id`, `X-Audit-State`, `X-Audit-Retry-Token`.

anya: agree. also add telemetry `runtime_unrecorded_changes_total{tenant}` and alert when >0 for 5m.

pat: I'll own the backend patch (make audit writes sync-durable or return 5xx). ETA: patch to staging in 3h, canary to prod overnight.

devex-bot: Created incident INC-2025-350 (P2) for "runtime-only flag mutation -> missing audit event". Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2025-350

anya: nice. small UX ask: when reconciliation finds an orphan, the console banner should show evidence (trace ids, request ids) and have two buttons: "Backfill audit" (requires short justification) and "Revert runtime" (posts revert to runtime and tags with `via:reconciler`).

pat: will add API stubs and headers. also make backfill idempotent by evidence-hash.

ops-bot: Note: no deployments in that window; agent overrides not implicated.
